name: Short Strap / Short Strip (Ratio Short Straddle)
summary: Sell two of one right and one of the other at the same ATM strike -- a short straddle with a deliberate directional lean. Unlimited risk, doubled on one side.

legs.strike_rule: ATM strike. (For the short STRIP, flip: sell 2 puts and 1 call at the same ATM strike.)

max_profit: total credit received, if the underlying finishes exactly at the strike
max_loss: UNDEFINED, and doubled on the heavy side. A short strap loses at 2x the rate above the strike, without limit.
breakevens: heavy side: strike + credit/(2*100) per share; light side: strike - credit/100 per share

greeks.delta: negative ~-0.50 per unit for a short strap at entry

when_to_use: Never on this account. Included only for family completeness. It is a short straddle with the tail risk deliberately doubled on one side, which is the opposite of what a risk-managed automated system should do.
entry_rules: BLOCKED ON THIS ACCOUNT and MARKED AS A BAD IDEA. Every leg is uncovered; this requires Level 4 naked authority, which Alpaca does not offer at any tier.
Defined-risk substitute that expresses the same view: a broken-wing iron butterfly, or an ATM credit vertical on the side you want to lean.
The router must hard-reject any order matching this shape.
management_rules: If it existed: take profit at 25% of credit, close at 21 DTE, stop at 1.5x credit (tighter than a symmetric short straddle because the heavy side loses twice as fast).
exit_rules: Would require a flatten by 15:30 ET on expiry, since one side is always ITM at expiry by construction.
Close any ITM short leg whose extrinsic drops below $0.10.
DIVIDEND GUARD on the call side.
assignment_risk: Extreme and doubled. The heavy side, when ITM, delivers 200 shares per unit. No covering legs exist.
buying_power: Reg-T naked on 3 contracts per unit; not available on Alpaca.
common_mistakes: Selling the extra contract for 'a little more credit' without noticing the tail doubled; running it because backtests of symmetric short straddles looked good.
zero_dte_notes: Not permitted, and 0DTE would make the doubled negative gamma catastrophic.
family: Two-leg verticals and same-expiry two-leg combos (call/put verticals, straddles, strangles, guts, synthetics/risk reversals, ratio verticals and backspreads)
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
